# Freedom with AI

> Freedom with AI provides strategic advisory for founders leveraging AI while building and growing companies. Founders work directly with Sonia Sarao or Cammie Clay.

The firm works across industries, especially where products, buying decisions, operations or regulation are complex.

## Advisory

[Advisory](https://freedomwith.ai/advisory) is the main business. Engagements begin with a three- or six-month term and are shaped around the company's priorities and the decisions in motion.

## Advisors

- Sonia Sarao: Strategic advisor with additional depth across product, technology, growth and AI. She led products and teams through growth and acquisition and now builds faibuddy, a live AI-native product for founders. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sonia-sarao/
- Cammie Clay: Strategic advisor with additional depth across regulation, risk, governance and stakeholder strategy. She was a regulator at the New York Stock Exchange and FINRA, then a compliance executive at RS Investments and First Republic Bank. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/cammieclay/

## Other work

- [faibuddy](https://faibuddy.com) is the firm's AI advisory product for founders.
- The firm is beginning to make selective private-market investments in founder-led companies, funds and aligned SPVs.
